# aether_registry_repository_tags (Data Source)

The tags of one repository in the organization's registry, served live from the registry. There is one entry per artifact and tag: an artifact with several tags appears once per tag (the same `digest` repeats), and an untagged artifact appears once with an empty `name`. Entries are sorted by `digest`, then `name`. A `null` `vulnerabilities` means the artifact has not been successfully scanned — distinct from zero findings. A repository that does not exist, or a registry that was never enabled, is an error.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) Repository name exactly as `aether_registry_repositories` returns it (plain, not URL-encoded; it can contain `/`, e.g. `team/app`).

### Read-Only

- `tags` (Attributes List) One entry per artifact and tag, sorted by `digest`, then `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `digest` (String) Artifact digest. Not unique across entries.
- `name` (String) Tag name; empty for an untagged artifact.
- `pulled_at` (String) Last pull time (RFC 3339); null when the artifact was never pulled.
- `pushed_at` (String) Push time (RFC 3339); null when the registry reports none.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Artifact size in bytes.
- `untagged` (Boolean) Whether the artifact has no tag.
- `vulnerabilities` (Attributes) Vulnerability counts of the last successful scan; null when the artifact has not been successfully scanned (not scanned, scan running or failed) — distinct from all zeros. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags--vulnerabilities))

<a id="nestedatt--tags--vulnerabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags.vulnerabilities`

Read-Only:

- `critical` (Number)
- `high` (Number)
- `low` (Number)
- `medium` (Number)
- `unknown` (Number)
